articles.translatedTitle: Misaki Umei releases “doodle spring,” which takes her into a new realm with live drums as her starting point.
articles.translatedExcerpt: On Wednesday, October 14, 2026, Misaki Umei released her new single “doodle spring”. This work is a completely new song that has never been performed live. Hayao Ebihara, a drummer who is active in various venues including Haruomi Hosono's band, participated in the production. The drums were recorded for sampling in the studio, and a large number of rhythm patterns and tones were recorded. Umei himself reconstructed the material, making use of the texture of the live drums and creating an organic rhythm and ensemble that was different from his previous work, "L a d y." This is then layered with synth bass and vocals that rise from the ultra-low range, creating a track with a unique groove in which numerous rhythms develop fluidly. In the lyrics, scenes such as ``bright blue'' and ``beautiful night'' are described, along with descriptions of physical pain such as ``glass still stuck in my foot.''
